newsitem.title: USA: World Access to acquire consulting service.
newsitem.headline: World Access to acquire consulting service.

text.p: World Access Inc said on Tuesday that it had agreed to acquire Galaxy Personal Communications Services Inc, a provider of engineering and consulting services to wireless telecommunications companies.
Terms of the agreement were not immediately available, but World Access said in a statement that it expected to benefit from the expertise of 30 Galaxy engineers as a result of the transaction.
World Access manufactures wireline and wireless switching, transmission and access products.
